The '''Churnis sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]], [[Fahariyn]], [[Gaulix]], [[Soltan]], [[Trauchta]], [[Sulomu]], [[Gilatter VIII]], [[Kalaan/Legends|Kalaan]], and [[Rustibar]] were located within this sector.

==History==
The Churnis sector was a sector with a presence of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. One of its leadership roles was the [[Secretary of Industry for Churnis]] that organized the [[Ore/Legends|ore]] production for the Alliance in the sector.<ref name="EAOC" />

Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Churnis sector was among the first sectors to throw off the Empire.<ref name="RECG" />
